  <defs>
   <!-- Glow filter for critical alerts -->
   <filter id="glow-red" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="blur"/>
      <feFlood flood-color="#F2495C" flood-opacity="0.6" result="color"/>
      <feComposite in="color" in2="blur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
      <feMerge>
         <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
         <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
   </filter>      
   <filter id="glow-green" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="blur"/>
      <feFlood flood-color="#73BF69" flood-opacity="0.4" result="color"/>
      <feComposite in="color" in2="blur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
      <feMerge>
         <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
         <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
   </filter>
   <!-- Pulse animation for critical nodes -->
   <style>
      @keyframes pulse-critical {
         0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
         50% { opacity: 0.3; }
      }
      .critical-pulse {
         animation: pulse-critical 1s ease-in-out infinite;
      }
   </style> -->

targets.query:
from(bucket: "eap_plh40")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "air_quality")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
       r._field == "temp" or r._field == "hum" or
       r._field == "co2"  or r._field == "pm1" or
       r._field == "pm10" or r._field == "pm25" or
       r._field == "iaq"  or r._field == "db" or
       r._field == "v"    or r._field == "rssi" or
       r._field == "voc"
  )
  |> group(columns: ["id", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["id", "_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
